narr: Heavy rain from a slowly moving warm front produced localized flooding in Southeast Texas.
ev: Three to six inches of rain fell in Hardin and Tyler Counties during the afternoon. Flash flooding at Votaw and a few surrounding communities created unpassable roads.
lsr: TRAINED SPOTTER REPORTED WATER OVER ROADWAY ON KIRKLAND RD. NEAR VOTAW, TX. PHOTO WAS RECEIVED VIA SOCIAL MEDIA.
